policy.slipRule: sample after coordinated preview; reuse preview unless sample < rate
policy.slipRandomness: same role search stream in production call order

sourceRelationship.treatmentSeam: machineCastPlan rootCharm preview plus production Normal 5% slip

fieldSemantics.coordinatedVsBlind: same board/hand and captured production tie-jitter prefix; longer counterfactual trees use a named diagnostic suffix; coordinated search receives projected SUNDER charm and blind search receives no root charm
fieldSemantics.castAttributableIncrement: wide SUNDER result minus a plain result using the same actual final column, board, hand, and live WARD state
fieldSemantics.incrementalBounty: incremental kills in BOUNTY (one banked point per additional destroyed die), zero in other modes
fieldSemantics.zeroIncrementalKillCast: wide placement destroyed no more dice than the same planned plain placement
fieldSemantics.zeroMarginalCast: wide and plain results have identical boards, charm, and killed count after the same planned move
fieldSemantics.liveWardValuation: coordinated root placement compared with the same projected SUNDER charm after clearing only enemy WARD marks, using identical captured jitter
fieldSemantics.wardAbsorption: number of warded wide strike outcomes and matching dice those WARDs protected

targetedSummary.scope: Targeted seat-neutral SUNDER outcomes pooled across requested replications
targetedSummary.limitation: This targeted substitution does not recompute the seven-mode ranked wheel or global dominance relations.
